description: Raw intraday stock trade-flow for one symbol. Views: 'recent' (recent stock trades, newest first), 'summary' (stock trade-flow totals), 'blocks' (large stock trades), 'history' (minute stock-flow buckets, newest first), 'cumulative' (cumulative net stock flow), 'bars' (multi-resolution OHLCV+flow bars, oldest first, for live chart feeds).

apiKey.description: FlashAlpha API key. Omit when calling via /mcp-oauth (OAuth flow); required on /mcp.

limit.description: Max trades returned (1–500, default 50). Only applies to 'recent'.

minutes.description: Window size in minutes for 'history', 'cumulative', or 'bars' (1–10080, default 60/240).

resolution.description: Bar resolution for 'bars' view: '1s', '1m', '5m', '15m', '30m', '1h', '4h'. Required when view='bars'.

name: get_stock_flow
title: Stock Trade Flow
